semantics.machine: Moore; output depends only on current state
semantics.clock: Original: all sequential logic triggered on positive edge of clk; apply one transition per rising edge
semantics.reset: Original: positive edge triggered asynchronous reset to A; areset high holds A at clock edges
semantics.initialization: Original specifies reset to A but no power-up state; do not initialize state, test defined behavior after reset
semantics.sampling: Check output after nonblocking state updates settle, and between rising edges to verify Moore behavior

numeric.states: Four distinct states, internal two-bit encoding

verification.oracle: Independent integer state model from original transition table
verification.coverage: All eight transitions; exhaustive 8-bit input sequences after reset; asynchronous reset from all states; reset held high; output stability between clock edges
verification.pass: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS only at completion

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before reset and behavior for unknown input values are unspecified; no defined expectations imposed for those cases.
